deadline.value: MSc/PhD: May 15 for Fall (September) 2027 entry; also Winter, Spring and Summer intakes.

gre_general.quote: We do not require GRE test scores for admission purposes.

gre_subject.quote: We do not require GRE test scores for admission purposes.

supervisor.value: A faculty member must agree to supervise you; applications without a secured supervisor are declined.
supervisor.quote: Thesis-based MSc and PhD applicants must have a faculty member agree to supervise their program before admission is approved. | Applications without a secured supervisor listed will not be reviewed for admission and will subsequently be declined.

funding.value: U of A guarantees every PhD student at least CAD 100,000 over years 1-4 and at least CAD 25,000 in year 1 (not sponsored or part-time students).
funding.quote: minimum guaranteed funding of $100K CAD over four years and not less than $25K CAD in their first year

entry_route.value: You can enter the PhD without a master's but must also complete the MSc coursework.
entry_route.quote: Students entering the PhD program who do not have a master’s degree are required to fulfill the MSc coursework requirement.

notes: Specializations include Conservation Biology, Forest Biology and Management, Land Reclamation, Soil Science, Water and Land Resources, Wildlife Ecology.
